events.title: Yang Jian proclaims himself Emperor Wen of Sui
events.description: Yang Jian, an official of the Northern Zhou, seized power and founded the Sui dynasty as Emperor Wen. In 589 he conquered the southern Chen dynasty, reuniting China after nearly three centuries of division.
events.html: Yang Jian, an official of the Northern Zhou, seized power and founded the Sui dynasty as Emperor Wen. In 589 he conquered the southern Chen dynasty, reuniting China after nearly three centuries of division.

events.title: Frederick Barbarossa elected King of Germany
events.description: The German princes chose Frederick of Hohenstaufen as king at Frankfurt. Crowned emperor in 1155, he fought repeated campaigns in Italy and clashed with the papacy until his death on crusade in 1190.
events.html: The German princes chose Frederick of Hohenstaufen as king at Frankfurt. Crowned emperor in 1155, he fought repeated campaigns in Italy and clashed with the papacy until his death on crusade in 1190.

events.title: The Mongols destroy the army of Vladimir on the Sit River
events.description: On the Sit, a tributary of the Mologa, the Mongol army of Batu Khan surprised and destroyed the forces of Grand Prince Yuri II of Vladimir, who was killed. The defeat ended organised resistance in north-eastern Rus'.

events.title: Edward IV proclaimed King of England
events.description: The Yorkist Edward, Earl of March, was proclaimed king in London, deposing the Lancastrian Henry VI. Weeks later he won the bloody Battle of Towton, securing his throne.
events.html: The Yorkist Edward, Earl of March, was proclaimed king in London, deposing the Lancastrian Henry VI. Weeks later he won the bloody Battle of Towton, securing his throne.

events.title: US Constitution takes effect as the first Congress meets
events.description: The new federal government began operation as Congress gathered at Federal Hall in New York, though it took weeks to reach a quorum. The Constitution is the oldest written national constitution still in force.
events.html: The new federal government began operation as Congress gathered at Federal Hall in New York, though it took weeks to reach a quorum. The Constitution is the oldest written national constitution still in force.

events.title: Abraham Lincoln inaugurated as 16th President
events.description: With seven states already seceded, Lincoln appealed to 'the better angels of our nature' in his inaugural address. War began at Fort Sumter five weeks later.
events.html: With seven states already seceded, Lincoln appealed to 'the better angels of our nature' in his inaugural address. War began at Fort Sumter five weeks later.

events.title: Tchaikovsky's 'Swan Lake' premieres at the Bolshoi
events.description: The first production in Moscow was poorly received. Revived in St Petersburg in 1895 with choreography by Petipa and Ivanov, it became the most famous of all ballets.
events.html: The first production in Moscow was poorly received. Revived in St Petersburg in 1895 with choreography by Petipa and Ivanov, it became the most famous of all ballets.

events.title: Franklin D. Roosevelt inaugurated in the depths of the Depression
events.description: With banks failing nationwide, Roosevelt told Americans 'the only thing we have to fear is fear itself'. In his first hundred days Congress passed a wave of New Deal legislation.
events.html: With banks failing nationwide, Roosevelt told Americans 'the only thing we have to fear is fear itself'. In his first hundred days Congress passed a wave of New Deal legislation.

events.title: John Lennon says the Beatles are 'more popular than Jesus'
events.description: The remark appeared in an interview in London's Evening Standard and passed unnoticed in Britain. Reprinted in the US months later, it led to record burnings and radio bans.
